_comment: Difficulty-scale regression guard. The golden.json guard protects ANSWERS; this protects the SCALE. Each anchor pins a question to the tiers a human considers defensible, so a re-tune of the cut points or penalty weights in calibrate.py fails the build instead of silently inverting the scale the way the authored labels did.

anchors.question: Which Devil Fruit did Monkey D. Luffy eat?
anchors.why: the single most-known fact in the series

anchors.question: The Luffy-Law alliance formed on Punk Hazard set its sights on toppling which of the Four Emperors?
anchors.why: a headline plot beat; shipped as hard

anchors.question: The World Government forbids all research into the roughly 100-year 'Void Century.' What are the only reliable records that can reveal its history?
anchors.why: Poneglyphs are core world lore; shipped as hard

anchors.question: In the Final Saga, which former small-time pirate and ex-Warlord was shockingly named one of the new Four Emperors?
anchors.why: Buggy as an Emperor is a famous gag; shipped as hard

anchors.question: Which of the Seven Warlords of the Sea did Zoro challenge at the Baratie, recognized as the world's greatest swordsman?

anchors.why: a whole East Blue arc happens here

anchors.question: During the two-year timeskip, Luffy trained on the uninhabited island of Rusukaina under the tutelage of which former pirate?

anchors.why: obscure subject shipped as easy off the page-length proxy
